speaker: Leonard
text: Yeah, Stephanie got 'em for me. Actually, I think it's more of a wool-fire-ant blend.

text: So the girlfriend's buying clothes for you, huh? Sounds serious.

speaker: Leonard
text: It is, actually. In fact, I gave it a lot of thought, and I decided it was time for us to have lived together.

speaker: Howard
text: Oh, Leonard, huge mistake. There's a whole buffet of women out there, and you're just standing in the corner eating the same deviled egg over and over again.

speaker: Leonard
text: At least I have an egg. What do you have?

speaker: Howard
text: A veritable smorgasbord of potential sexual partners. See the blonde over there? I can hit on her, and you can't.

text: Too bad, 'cause she was checking you out before. Of course not. Look at her.

speaker: Leonard
text: I don't care what you guys think. Stephanie and I are very happy living together. I will give either of you twenty dollars right now to trade vans with me.
